summary: Southern end of a parked-up residential street, steep, with homes 11-12 m away.
reasons: Dwellings 11-12 m on the same side

best_section.where: West kerb at the south end, by the junction with the cross street

drivers.seclusion: Houses 11-12 m behind trees on the west side; homes and apartments across the road.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed street with cars already parked both sides; room for a van.
drivers.traffic: Residential street near a busy arterial junction at the north end.
drivers.convention: Cars parked along the kerb; 2P signs apply Mon-Fri 7am-7pm with resident permits excepted.

flags: Steep: about 8% here, 13.5% mean over the stretch
Dwellings 10-25 m away on the same side
Arterial road noise near the north end
sun_shade: Heavy tree cover on the west side shades the morning; open to afternoon sun.
